name: Saladin
description: A single warp nacelle beneath a familiar saucer. The compact destroyer reduces the heavy cruiser to its essential silhouette.
drawingNote: The plate’s front view draws the nacelle about 20 % larger than its plan and side views; the model follows plan and side, and its nacelle tapers as drawn.

name: Hermes
description: The scout shares the destroyer’s basic hull arrangement. Its lighter armament marks a different mission within the same family.
drawingNote: The plate’s front view draws the nacelle about 20 % larger than its plan and side views; the model follows plan and side, and its nacelle tapers as drawn.

name: Ptolemy
description: Two low-mounted nacelles and an aft tow pad define the fleet’s transport platform. This study depicts the tug without a cargo container.
drawingNote: The plate’s front view draws the saucer about 1 m thinner than its side view; the model follows plan and side.

name: Federation
description: A larger saucer, a deep secondary hull and a third dorsal nacelle create the manual’s most imposing starship profile.
drawingNote: Hull to hull matches the printed 87 m within 0.5 %; the drawn aft nacelle fairings bring the overall height to 88.5 m. The front view draws the dorsal unit about 2 m lower than the side view; the model follows plan and side.
